description: This Java class 'KeycloakUserService' provides services to manage users via Keycloak, including creating, updating, and reading user details by email or ID.

classes.name: KeycloakUserService
classes.description: Service class for managing Keycloak users, handling creation, update, and retrieval operations.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user in Keycloak and returns the response status code.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Updates an existing user's information in Keycloak.

methods.name: readUserByEmail
methods.description: Searches for users by email address.

methods.name: readUser
methods.description: Retrieves user details by user ID; throws an exception if user is not found.
